programme.title: Tender Poisoner
programme.desc: An executive (Howard Duff) plans to end an associate's (Dan Dailey) love affair and save the man's career and marriage.

programme.title: Festive Season
programme.desc: A lawyer (Edmon Ryan) spends Christmas Eve trying to reconcile a feuding brother (Richard Waring) and sister (Carmen Mathews).

programme.title: Listen, Listen ... !
programme.desc: A man tries to convince the authorities that he knows who committed the latest murder in a series of strangulations, but no one will listen to him.

programme.title: Post-Mortem
programme.desc: A woman (Joanna Moore) learns that a winning sweepstakes ticket is in the suit her former husband was buried in. With Steve Forrest and James Gregory.

programme.title: The Crocodile Case
programme.desc: A crocodile valise becomes a vital clue in tracking down a murderer (Denholm Elliott).

programme.title: The Safe Place
programme.desc: A bank teller (Robert H. Harris) invents a seemingly foolproof plan to come up with a lot of quick cash. With Jerry Paris and Philip Pine.

programme.title: The Canary Sedan
programme.desc: While traveling in chauffeured car, a woman (Jessica Tandy) with psychic powers hears a voice telling a tragic love story.

programme.title: Impromptu Murder
programme.desc: A lawyer, soon to become mayor, extends an invitation to a woman who once accused him of embezzlement.

programme.title: Little White Frock
programme.desc: An old, unemployed actor (Herbert Marshall) uses an even older ploy to get a part in a play. With Tom Helmore and Julia Adams.

programme.title: Don't Interrupt
programme.desc: A couple (Biff McGuire, Cloris Leachman) on a train promise their son money if he doesn't interrupt a cowboy's (Chill Wills) story.

programme.title: The Jokester
programme.desc: A morgue attendant becomes hysterical when a practical joker pulls the ultimate prank and pretends to be a corpse.

programme.title: Crooked Road
programme.desc: A couple (Richard Kiley, Pat Breslin) falls prey to a crooked policeman (Walter Matthau) and corrupt town officials.

programme.title: $2,000,000 Defense
programme.desc: Desperate for an acquittal, a man (Leslie Nielsen) makes a lucrative deal with his defense lawyer (Barry Sullivan).

programme.title: Design for Loving
programme.desc: A man (Norman Lloyd) plots to get away from his wife (Marian Seldes) for a while without her knowing.

programme.title: Man With a Problem
programme.desc: A man (Gary Merrill) on the ledge of a New York City hotel threatens suicide after his wife's (Elizabeth Montgomery) death.

programme.title: Safety of the Witness
programme.desc: A gun shop owner (Art Carney) witnesses the murder of a state witness by two gangsters. With Mary Scott.

programme.title: Murder Me Twice
programme.desc: Hypnosis figures in the case of a woman (Phyllis Thaxter) on trial for the murder of her husband. With Tom Helmore.

programme.title: Tea Time
programme.desc: A mistress confronts her rich lover's wife, hoping to convince the woman to give her husband a divorce.

programme.title: And the Desert Shall Blossom
programme.desc: A sheriff (Ben Johnson) worries about two elderly hermits (William Demarest, Roscoe Ates) with an escaped killer on the loose.

programme.title: Mrs. Herman & Mrs. Fenimore
programme.desc: A woman (Doro Merande) plots the murder of her penny-pinching uncle with the help of her actress boarder (Mary Astor).

programme.title: Six People, No Music
programme.desc: A mortician (John McGiver) is torn when a dead man (Howard Smith) revives to make his own funeral plans.

programme.title: Morning After
programme.desc: A mother (Jeanette Nolan) gets involved when she discovers her daughter is seeing a married man (Robert Alda).

programme.title: A Personal Matter
programme.desc: A killer (Joe Maross) escapes to an isolated construction site where he suspects a new engineer (Wayne Morris).

programme.title: Out There, Darkness
programme.desc: A rich woman refuses to lend money to the man who walks her dog when he requests a loan, claiming to need the money to help his girlfriend.

programme.title: Total Loss
programme.desc: A woman (Nancy Gates) enlists her boyfriend's (Ralph Meeker) help to torch her struggling business for the insurance.

programme.title: The Last Dark Step
programme.desc: A man (Robert Horton) tries to get away from one woman (Fay Spain) so he can marry another (Joyce Meadows).

programme.title: Morning of the Bride
programme.desc: A woman (Barbara Bel Geddes) grows suspicious when her fiancé (Don Dubbins) postpones meetings with his mother.

programme.title: The Diamond Necklace
programme.desc: A man is told he has to retire from his job at the jewelry store where he has worked most of his life.

programme.title: Relative Value
programme.desc: A young man (Denholm Elliott) schemes to speed up his inheritance of his rich uncle's (Torin Thatcher) estate.

programme.title: The Right Price
programme.desc: A burglar bargains with his victims when he discovers robbery will not be as profitable as collecting on a life insurance policy.

programme.title: I'll Take Care of You
programme.desc: A used car salesman (Ralph Meeker) is driven to murder by his big-spending wife. With Russell Collins and Ida Moore.

programme.title: The Avon Emeralds
programme.desc: A detective (Roger Moore) trails an elegant woman (Hazel Court) suspected of smuggling an emerald necklace.

programme.title: The Kind Waitress
programme.desc: A waitress (Olive Deering) plots murder after learning she has been included in a wealthy patron's will.

programme.title: Cheap Is Cheap
programme.desc: A miserly man (Dennis Day) searches for the cheapest method of murdering his spendthrift wife.

programme.title: The Waxwork
programme.desc: A reporter gets permission from the owner of a wax museum to spend the night in the museum section devoted to murderers.

programme.title: The Impossible Dream
programme.desc: A smitten woman (Carmen Mathews) sees the chance for her dream to come true when she witnesses a murder. With Franchot Tone and Mary Astor.

programme.title: Banquo's Chair
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Williams) arranges a unique ruse to capture a killer. With Hilda Plowright and Kenneth Haigh.

programme.title: The 31st of February
programme.desc: A suspicious sergeant (William Conrad) digs when a death is labeled accidental. With David Wayne.

programme.title: What Really Happened
programme.desc: A woman (Anne Francis) stands trial for her husband's murder, and the family maid (Ruth Roman) holds the key to the truth.

programme.title: Forecast: Low Clouds, Coastal Fog
programme.desc: A woman (Inger Stevens) thinks her refusal of the use of her phone led to a murder. With Dan O'Herlihy.

programme.title: A Tangled Web
programme.desc: A girl's (Zohra Lampert) deep love for a compulsive thief (Robert Redford) infuriates his jealous accomplice (Barry Morse).

programme.title: To Catch a Butterfly
programme.desc: When a young couple moves into a new neighborhood, they find their lives threatened by the little boy next door.

programme.title: The Paragon
programme.desc: A man (Gary Merrill) must stop his wife (Joan Fontaine) from alienating family and friends.

programme.title: I'll Be Judge, I'll Be Jury
programme.desc: The relatives (Ed Nelson, Sarah Marshall) of a murdered newlywed decide to bring the killer to justice. With Peter Graves.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Danger
programme.desc: An anthrax epidemic devastates Los Angeles, and authorities race to find the carrier. With Michael Parks.

programme.title: A Night With the Boys
programme.desc: Fearing his pregnant wife's (Joyce Meadows) displeasure, a man (John Smith) fakes being mugged to cover poker losses.

programme.title: Your Witness
programme.desc: A woman, dissatisfied in her marriage to a philandering attorney, decides to take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Human Interest Story
programme.desc: A man declaring he is from Mars (Arthur Hill) is interviewed by a newspaper reporter (Steve McQueen).

programme.title: The Dusty Drawer
programme.desc: A man (Dick York) seeks revenge on a bank clerk (Philip Coolidge) who once stole some money from him.

programme.title: A True Account
programme.desc: A woman (Jane Greer) consults an attorney (Robert Webber) about her husband (Kent Smith), whom she believes is a murderer.

programme.title: Touché
programme.desc: A husband (Paul Douglas) arranges for a young man (Robert Morse) to kill his wife's latest beau in a duel.

programme.title: Invitation to an Accident
programme.desc: When a cheating wife is in an accident, her jealous husband is confronted about his possible involvement with the incident.

programme.title: Arthur
programme.desc: A chicken farmer murders his gold-digging girlfriend, but the police can't convict him without the body.

programme.title: The Crystal Trench
programme.desc: The loyal widow (Patricia Owens) of a man killed in a mountain-climbing accident recovers his body after 20 years.

programme.title: Appointment at Eleven
programme.desc: An angry young man (Clint Kimbrough) accurately predicts an impending death. With Amy Douglass and Norma Crane.

programme.title: Coyote Moon
programme.desc: A professor (Macdonald Carey) traveling across the country outwits three larcenous hitchhikers.

programme.title: No Pain
programme.desc: A man (Brian Keith) destined to live in an iron lung fears for his life after learning of his wife's (Joanna Moore) infidelity.

programme.title: Anniversary Gift
programme.desc: A hen-pecked husband (Harry Morgan) plans to give his animal-loving wife (Barbara Baxley) a poisonous snake as an anniversary gift.

programme.title: Dry Run
programme.desc: A young thug (Robert Vaughn) tries to prove his worth to a mob boss (David White) by killing a rival mobster (Walter Matthau).

programme.title: The Blessington Method
programme.desc: The representative (Dick York) of a society dedicated to eliminating the elderly makes an offer to a prospective client (Henry Jones).

programme.title: Dead Weight
programme.desc: A man (Joseph Cotten) decides to get rid of one potential blackmailer (Don Gordon) only to deal with another. With Julia Adams.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: A boy's (Peter Lazer) hobby of growing mushrooms in his cellar turns into a nightmare. With Steve Dunne and Beatrice Straight.

programme.title: Road Hog
programme.desc: A father (Raymond Massey) seeks revenge against a road hog (Robert Emhardt) who caused his son's death.

programme.title: Specialty of the House
programme.desc: A man's (Robert Morley) dream of becoming a lifetime member of an exclusive gourmet restaurant comes true.

programme.title: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programme.desc: A Southerner (Ronald Howard) is about to be hanged for attempting to destroy a bridge vital to the Union's advance.

programme.title: Graduating Class
programme.desc: A teacher (Wendy Hiller) at an exclusive girls' school becomes too involved in the life of one of her students (Gigi Perreau). With Robert H. Harris.

programme.title: The Ikon of Elijah
programme.desc: A man's (Oscar Homolka) dream of sudden wealth takes solid form when he learns the location of a treasured icon. With Sam Jaffe.

programme.title: The Cure
programme.desc: When it becomes evident his wife is losing her grip on reality, a man turns to his devoted servant for help in the Amazon.

programme.title: Backward, Turn Backward
programme.desc: When a man is murdered, suspicion falls on his teen daughter's (Phyllis Love) middle-aged suitor (Tom Tully). With Alan Baxter and Rebecca Welles.

programme.title: Not the Running Type
programme.desc: After embezzling $200,000, a man turns himself in to the authorities but refuses to return the money.

programme.title: The Day of the Bullet
programme.desc: When a friend (Barry Gordon) is killed, a man (John Craven) reminisces about an incident in their past. With Dennis Patrick.

programme.title: Hitch Hike
programme.desc: A businessman (John McIntire) has second thoughts about having picked up a young hitchhiker (Robert Morse). With Suzanne Pleshette.

programme.title: Across the Threshold
programme.desc: A son (George Grizzard) encourages his controlling mother (Patricia Collinge) to join her dead husband.

programme.title: Craig's Will
programme.desc: A man (Dick Van Dyke) and his greedy girlfriend (Stella Stevens) will get rich when his deceased aunt's dog dies.

programme.title: Madame Mystery
programme.desc: A studio publicist (Joby Baker) takes advantage of a star's (Audrey Totter) demise to hype her final film.

programme.title: The Little Man Who Was There
programme.desc: A little man enters a mining town and challenges two miners to a contest with surprising results.

programme.title: Mother, May I Go Out to Swim?
programme.desc: A mama's boy (William Shatner) is afraid to tell his mother (Jessie Royce Landis) about his wedding plans.

programme.title: The Cuckoo Clock
programme.desc: A woman (Beatrice Straight) in an isolated cabin encounters a stranger (Fay Spain) she believes is an escaped mental patient.

programme.title: Forty Detectives Later
programme.desc: A man's (George Mitchell) search for his wife's murderer leads to a confrontation. With James Franciscus and Jack Weston.

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: Aboard a ship bound for South Africa, a businessman (Eric Portman) meets a partner (Oscar Homolka) he left for dead.

programme.title: The Lonely Hour
programme.desc: A deranged woman kidnaps a 7-month-old boy who she believes is her son while renting a room at a woman's farmhouse.

programme.title: The Star Juror
programme.desc: After a mild-mannered man commits a strangulation, he becomes a juror in the trial of the man accused of the crime.

programme.title: The Long Silence
programme.desc: A paralyzed woman (Phyllis Thaxter) must somehow communicate her husband is a killer before she becomes his next victim.

programme.title: An Out for Oscar
programme.desc: After a naive man (Larry Storch) weds a beautiful woman (Linda Christian), he learns she did not marry him for love.

programme.title: Death and the Joyful Woman
programme.desc: The secretary (Laraine Day) of a wine baron murders when her dream of marrying him is shattered.

programme.title: Last Seen Wearing Blue Jeans
programme.desc: A girl (Katherine Crawford) gets into the wrong car at an Arizona café and witnesses a murder in Mexico.

programme.title: The Dark Pool
programme.desc: After an adopted son drowns, a strange woman (Madlyn Rhue) arrives claiming to be the boy's natural mother.

programme.title: Dear Uncle George
programme.desc: A syndicated advice columnist receives a letter from an old busybody which leads the journalist to irrationality and murder.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.title: Tremors 3: Back to Perfection
programme.desc: Legendary monster-killer Burt Gummer has returned to Perfection, Nev., scene of the original attacks by the worm creatures with razor teeth known as graboids. Sure enough, the creatures attack again, only now they're split into graboids, shriekers and a new mutation known as ass-blasters, which are propelled into flight by combustible flatulence. It's up to Burt, Jack Sawyer and other locals to save their town from destruction.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: A Cold Day in Hell
programme.desc: Burt Gummer suspects that giant worms are being utilized as weapons at a research facility in Canada. He soon finds himself in a race against time to create an antidote from one of the creature's venom to save his own life.

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop."

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: Although she has an excellent job at the Metropolitan Museum of Art and a fabulous apartment with model roommates, New Yorker Amanda Pierce remains unlucky in love and intent on finding the right guy. When she develops a crush on neighbor Jim Winston, she begins to spy on him and witnesses his apparent involvement in a murder. Since things don't add up, she tries to figure out what really happened — and if she still has a shot at dating the guy.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: In this 90s classic, a suicidal, career alcoholic falls for a compassionate Las Vegas hooker.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: When a Valley Girl finds love with a rocker, her girlfriends find him "grody to the max!"

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Susan
programme.desc: A bump on the head has bored housewife (Rosanna Arquette) believing she is the mysterious Susan (Madonna).

programme.title: Mr. Mom
programme.desc: Jack and Caroline are a happy couple... until a layoff makes him a house husband and her a working wife!

programme.title: Yours, Mine And Ours
programme.desc: A widowed nurse (Lucille Ball) and her EIGHT kids get together with a widower (Henry Fonda) and his TEN kids!

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Jack Lemmon and Shirley MacLaine are delightful in this tale of love and ambition.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: In this madcap farce, two Chicago musicians disguise themselves as women to avoid the mob.

programme.title: Sweet Smell Of Success
programme.desc: Burt Lancaster and Tony Curtis star in this classic as a ruthless journalist and an unscrupulous press agent.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones (1958)
programme.desc: Two convicts on the run are bound together by an unbreakable chain and separated by unbridled hatred.

programme.title: Paris Blues
programme.desc: Ram and Eddie are two jazz musicians living in Paris and falling in love with two young American girls.

programme.title: In The Heat Of The Night
programme.desc: Sidney Poitier and Rod Steiger shine in this classic mystery-thriller that took home five Academy Awards®.

programme.title: Little Man Tate
programme.desc: Jodie Foster makes her directorial debut and stars in this drama about a single mother and her son.

programme.title: Charlie Bartlett
programme.desc: The kids at Western Summit High have "issues," and newcomer Charlie Bartlett is coming to their rescue.

programme.title: Hot Tub Time Machine
programme.desc: Four pals party all night in a hot tub and wake up--in 1986--and must survive the 80s...again.

programme.title: Hot Tub Time Machine 2
programme.desc: The hot tub time machine is fired up again for more side-splitting adventures, this time in the future!

programme.title: How It Ends
programme.desc: A woman embarks on a journey through LA in hopes of making it to her last party before the world ends.

programme.title: Best Men
programme.desc: A young woman wants the wedding day, despite the fact that the groomsmen have decided to rob a bank.

programme.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
programme.desc: Two con men bet on who can bilk $50,000 from a wealthy woman in this dirty, rotten comedy!

programme.title: Clifford
programme.desc: Martin Short stars as a ten-year-old who plans revenge on his uncle (Charles Grodin).

programme.title: UHF
programme.desc: Weird Al Yankovic plays a daydreamer who becomes the manager of a TV station that's losing ratings and money.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventure
programme.desc: Our righteous heroes Bill and Ted discover their destiny in a time-travelling phone booth! Excellent!

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Bogus Journey
programme.desc: The titular time travelers become history when they wind up face to face with the Grim Reaper!

programme.title: Teen Wolf (1985)
programme.desc: In this classic comedy, a teenager's life is improved when his werewolf nature bursts through!

programme.title: Child's Play (1988)
programme.desc: Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

programme.title: River's Edge
programme.desc: A powerful portrait of disaffected teens based on the horrifying real-life murder of a young California girl.

programme.title: Showgirls
programme.desc: Passion and power struggles unfold when a young woman will do anything to make it as a Las Vegas showgirl!

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Lone Star Shark 3
programme.desc: Two female survivors join forces to bring down the deadly group responsible for unleashing a hungry shark in a West Texas lake.

programme.title: Night of the Rising Dead

programme.desc: In the class-obsessed and religiously divided United Kingdom of the early 1920s, two determined young runners train for the 1924 Paris Olympics. Eric Liddell (Ian Charleson), a devout Christian born to Scottish missionaries in China, sees running as part of his worship of God's glory and refuses to train or compete on the Sabbath. Harold Abrahams (Ben Cross) overcomes anti-Semitism and class bias, but neglects his beloved sweetheart Sybil (Alice Krige) in his single-minded quest.

programme.title: Almost Heroes
programme.desc: Two explorers are racing Lewis and Clark to the Pacific Ocean in 1804. Edwards (Matthew Perry) is a glory-seeking fop who's out of his league, Hunt (Chris Farley) is a slovenly, clumsy tracker with a soft spot for toilet humor. Along with a team of misfits and losers, the duo wreaks havoc on the American frontier.

programme.desc: Dylan Ramsey (David Spade) is getting ready to open his own restaurant, but he's become preoccupied his new neighbor, a gorgeous Frenchwoman named Lila (Sophie Marceau). When Dylan doesn't have much luck talking to her, he decides that the way to her heart may be through her beloved dog, Jack. Abducting the canine, Dylan hopes to win Lila's affection when he returns Jack safe and sound, but soon the scheming guy has to deal with numerous unforeseen problems that jeopardize his plan.

programme.title: Joe Versus the Volcano
programme.desc: Joe Banks (Tom Hanks) is dying, apparently. This is good news, since his life was not much worth living anyway. On the upside, a strange millionaire (Lloyd Bridges) offers Joe a way to die with meaning and dignity: by hurling himself into a volcano. With plenty of spending cash and an ensemble of new luggage, Joe embarks on an absurdist journey to his demise, guided by two very disparate sisters, and trying to puzzle out the meaning of existence.

programme.title: One Crazy Summer
programme.desc: After graduating from high school, art school hopeful Hoops McCann (John Cusack) struggles to complete his application to the Rhode Island School of Design. programme.title: The Hudsucker Proxy
programme.desc: Greedy executive Sidney J. Mussburger (Paul Newman) hopes to take control of the company he works for by purchasing a majority share -- but he must first devalue the stock. So he convinces the board to appoint know-nothing recent graduate Norville Barnes (Tim Robbins). But Mussburger's plot backfires when Barnes' latest invention succeeds, thereby increasing the company's value. programme.title: Hold Your Breath
programme.desc: A group of friends on a roadtrip explore a cemetery where the ghost of a notorious serial killer jumps from body to body, killing his victims one by one.

programme.title: Escape from Altura
programme.desc: 10K nearly loses everything as Panic and anti-Talker sentiments flare after an explosion derails the vote.

programme.title: Insect
programme.desc: After ecological disaster causes the collapse of modern civilization, two sisters venture out from their fortified compound when their mother is severely wounded after scavenging bandits attempt to raid their home. The only advantage the sisters have is a super-charged armored muscle car.

programme.title: Ghosthunters
programme.desc: When one of their own loses his wife and daughter at the hands of a serial killer, a team of ghost hunters is determined to capture the spirits of the loved ones so their spirits can finally rest in peace. But as the team goes deeper into the house, the ghosts become more hostile, and the group discovers the true secrets of the house and its murderer.

programme.title: Alien Predator
programme.desc: A black ops reconnaissance team is sent to investigate the crash of an unidentified aircraft. There, they discover that they are being hunted by an alien expedition to Earth.

programme.title: 666: The Child
programme.desc: After a plane crash, where a boy is the only survivor, a childless couple adopts him and soon discovers he is something very powerful, something very dark. This small boy is the Beast, and with him, he carries the Beginning of the End.

programme.title: Almighty Thor
programme.desc: When the demon god Loki destroys the fortress of Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero Thor can protect Earth from armageddon.

programme.title: Philly Feast
programme.desc: Out to get Cassandra back, her bizarre and dangerous "family" of cannibals catches up with the team and kidnaps Addy, endangering the mission.

programme.title: Jungle Run
programme.desc: A search for their missing father turns deadly when sibling adventurers find themselves viciously attacked by jungle animals. But as they fight back against the relentless onslaught they start to realize something much more sinister may be behind the attacks.

programme.title: Zombie Road
programme.desc: Our Heroes manage to finally track Murphy down and are introduced to "Z-Weed," an ultra-potent strain of marijuana grown in zombie compost. They go on a quest for "Batch 47," a potential cure for the Zombie Virus.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the destructive power of the giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, A.I. Mecha Ape. Its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the imprisoned giant Ape to stop the robot.

programme.title: No Mercy: Part 1
programme.desc: In this "FLASHBACK MOVIE," the old crew meet a feral kid who leads them to Mercy Laboratories, a mysterious compound of survivors awaiting the return of "The Man," a villain of the Apocalypse who carries around a list of soon-to-disappear people.

programme.title: Ardennes Fury
programme.desc: As the Battle of the Bulge rages on, an American tank unit gets trapped behind Nazi lines. With just hours before the bombs of Operation Ardennes Fury fall, the tank's commander makes the risky decision to rescue an orphanage.

programme.title: Street Racer
programme.desc: After recovering from a tragic accident, a former street racer struggles to redeem himself and join the elite racing world.

programme.title: 24 Hours to D-Day
programme.desc: Just hours before D-Day, American Special Forces are tasked with parachuting in the dead of night into German-con- trolled France to guide the 101st Airborne assault ahead of the landings at Normandy. They must work together, avoid German capture, and get location and drop zone beacons on all before the Allied invasion of France begins.

programme.title: Mega Shark vs Crocosaurus
programme.desc: The massive prehistoric shark has survived the last battle, and the world is again threatened when a new, more dangerous foe is discovered in the jungles of Africa.

programme.title: Shapeshifter
programme.desc: Inmates and guards alike become trapped in a maximum security prison when they fall prey to a demonic beast that feeds on human flesh.

programme.title: Zoombies
programme.desc: When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.

programme.title: Social Nightmare
programme.desc: An A-student's life is turned upside-down when inappropriate status updates and photos appear on her online profile. Soon, she learns that even her life is in danger.

programme.title: Doc's Stoned History
programme.desc: Skeezy and Sketchy re-enact Doc's stories of the Founding Fathers. Warren and the others search for the bizkit bakery and the secret ingredient in them.

programme.title: Corporate Retreat
programme.desc: Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!

programme.title: Devil's Triangle
programme.desc: When a group of marine biologists crash land in the Bermuda Triangle, they realize they have stumbled into the lost city of Atlantis. But they quickly discover the city isn't friendly, and its humanoid inhabitants are planning worldwide domination using the piles of weapons and technology that have fallen through the Triangle over the centuries.

programme.title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: Due to a scientific experiment gone awry, a research team ends up in a strange land below the earth's crust. There they must fend off a series of strange creatures, including vicious dinosaurs and spiders. Meanwhile, above ground, Emily Radford helps military official Joseph Harnet with his plan to save the stranded research team. Their strategy is to use a high-powered drill to bore their way to the researchers, one of whom is Emily's sister.

programme.title: Invasion of the Pod People
programme.desc: After a woman's closest friends and co-workers undergo extreme personality changes, she begins to suspect that they have been replaced by malevolent alien invaders.

programme.title: Super Cyclone
programme.desc: When a super cyclone threatens the entire American eastern seaboard, a lone meteorologist and a petroleum engineer must battle the elements to stop the threat.

programme.title: No Mercy: Part 2
programme.desc: In this "FLASHBACK MOVIE," the old crew meet a feral kid who leads them to Mercy Laboratories, a mysterious compound of survivors awaiting the return of "The Man," a villain of the Apocalypse who carries around a list of soon-to-disappear people.

programme.title: The Day the Earth Stopped
programme.desc: Hundreds of massive intergalactic robots appear in all of the major world capitals with an ultimatum: Prove the value of human civilization or be destroyed.

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: Murphy is captured by an overly enthusiastic and slightly unbalanced zombie fan, "The Collector." Murphy must match wits with the Collector if he's to survive, much less escape.

programme.title: The Terminators
programme.desc: In the near future, people utilize cyborgs for labor, but the vastly intelligent robots rebel against their masters and begin to take over human civilization through mass destruction. A small group of survivors, led by Sheriff Reed Carpenter (A Martinez), plans to stop the cyborgs, tapping inventor Kurt Ross (Jeremy London) for help. Using a space shuttle designed by Ross, Carpenter and his team head for a control center in outer space that has the power to shut down the machines.

programme.title: Transmorphers
programme.desc: A race of alien robots has conquered the Earth and forced humanity underground. After three hundred years of domination, a small group of humans develop a plan to defeat the mechanical invaders in the ultimate battle between man and machine.

programme.title: Meteor Moon
programme.desc: When a meteor crashes into the moon and shifts its axis, Earth's gravity pulls the moon into the path of the planet. Now, a group of scientists must figure out how to stop the moon from hitting the earth before it's too late.

programme.title: 3 Musketeers
programme.desc: Alexandra D'Artagnan, junior NSA officer, uncovers a plot to assasinate the President of the United States and enlists the help of three infamous international spies to stop the threat.

programme.title: Mail, Nails, Jail
programme.desc: The jail's Special Operations Group is called in to deal with a difficult inmate; a well-known inmate returns to jail, but this time, he's in with his girlfriend, who might be harboring a secret that could dramatically affect both their lives.

programme.title: Two Degrees of Murder
programme.desc: A pregnant woman faces the charge of killing her husband two months away from giving birth; her future lies in the hands of a judge; another inmate, also facing a murder charge, pays a price when he disobeys orders.

programme.title: Baptism by Fire
programme.desc: Inside Suffolk County Jail, one inmate finds himself on the wrong end of a vicious attack; another, with a reputation for violence, keeps the staff on constant alert; a young man with a bright future awaits trial for first-degree murder.

programme.desc: Correctional officers are outnumbered 10 to 1 and are constantly searching over 1,000 inmates to find their home-made weapons, which are very easy to conceal; hours after the Lock-Up crew wraps shooting, an inmate is stabbed in the honor dorm.

programme.title: Blue Balloons
programme.desc: A young couple comes to jail after a crime spree, but their stories don't add up; one of the jail's most prolific contraband smugglers makes her return, but staff cracks down on the pipeline.

programme.desc: For some inmates, the only way out of prison is "paroling legit," or leaving in a body bag; others earn a lump sum of good time by completing programs or holding a prison job, while a few will take any chance to try to escape.
